name: tribe-green
description: Tribe Green catalogue and enquiry system: backend API, website and Android app in one repo

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix web && npm install --prefix mobile
scripts.dev:site: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors green,blue "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix web && npm run typecheck --prefix mobile && npm run lint --prefix mobile
